report.title: INC-2026-1108 — PERSON 01 Room Scan: Entry, Object Handling, and Tracking Gap
report.summary:
PERSON 01 entered the Polycam LiDAR scanned room at ~4.22 s and was last seen exiting at ~25.13 s (40‑second recording). The subject was observed across all four cameras but with highly uneven coverage: cam3 provided the initial observation, cam2 had the second‑longest continuous runs (5.4–8.2 s and later 14.4–16.5 s, 22.4–25.1 s), and cam1 had the longest single continuous observation (8.4–15.6 s). cam4 captured only two brief visibility windows (11.2 s and 13.4 s). 

Two human‑reviewed object‑handling windows were identified: a laptop carried from 12.0 s to 14.6 s, and a chair carried from 14.8 s to 24.8 s (moved from near the NW side to the far SE zone, z ≈ –5.87 m). A 2.1‑s tracking gap (16.51–18.57 s) has ESTIMATED (interpolated) positions only; the subject was not observed by any camera in this interval.

Notable events: entry (cam3, 4.22 s), first laptop handling (12–14.6 s), chair handling begins (14.8 s), tracking gap (16.51–18.57 s), exit (cam2, 25.13 s). Evidence status distinguishes observed camera annotations from interpolated positions in the gap.

cameraEvidence.summary: Longest continuous observation (8.4–15.6 s); 14 manual annotations; tracked subject from near‑entry to far‑wall zone. Brief out‑of‑frame mark at 4.33 s and outlier rejection at 22.14 s and 22.72 s.
Three observation runs: 5.4–8.2 s, 14.4–16.5 s, 22.4–25.1 s; total ~7 s of observed time; last seen at exit (25.13 s). Rejected observation at 14.41 s conflicted with cam1 track.
Initial entry observation (4.22 s); three brief re‑observations at 6.56 s, 9.77 s, 12.79 s; last at 12.79 s. Limited coverage after subject moved toward cam1's view.
Two very brief observations only: 11.18 s and 13.36 s (each ~1 s window). Subject largely outside cam4's narrower FOV (40.7°).

uncertainties.description: Tracking gap 16.51–18.57 s: subject not observed by any camera; positions at 17.03 s, 17.54 s, 18.06 s are ESTIMATED (interpolated, NOT observed).
Object positions (laptop, chair) are derived from subject carrier position at start/end of each carry window; the objects themselves are not independently tracked.

Two rejected observations in the fused trajectory: obs_mw7ootx5_4zij0 (cam1, 22.14 s, outlier 0.54 m off track, implies >3 m/s) and obs_mw7ooww1_kizgv (cam1, 22.72 s, outlier 0.94 m off track, implies >3 m/s).

recommendedActions.action: Review footage from the tracking gap (16.51–18.57 s) to confirm interpolated trajectory and check for any missed camera coverage.
Verify laptop and chair handoff positions with independent object tracking if available; currently positions are subject‑derived estimates.
Investigate the two rejected cam1 outliers (22.14 s, 22.72 s) to determine whether they represent genuine speed spikes or annotation errors.
